items.title: Third-party risk policy - vendor register
items.body: Two independent tests apply to every approved vendor. (1) A vendor that processes personal or health data must have an unexpired data processing agreement (DPA), whatever its tier. (2) A critical or high tier vendor must have an unexpired security report. A vendor failing either test is set to under_review and gets a finding naming the vendor: severity high if it processes personal or health data, otherwise medium.
